arguments.title: Token still valid after logout
arguments.explanation: logout() only pops a local dictionary, so validate() keeps accepting the token after the user has signed out.
arguments.reproducer:
from payments.auth import session
t = session.login('alice')
assert session.validate(t)
print('CONTROL_OK')
session.logout(t)
print('REPRODUCED' if session.validate(t) else 'NOT REPRODUCED')

arguments.title: Tokens can be forged with the built-in default secret
arguments.explanation: When PAYMENTS_TOKEN_SECRET is unset the signing secret is a fixed string, so anyone can mint a token that is_authentic() accepts.
arguments.reproducer:
import hashlib
import hmac
from payments.auth import tokens
t = tokens.issue('alice', 1)
assert tokens.is_authentic(t)
print('CONTROL_OK')
mac = hmac.new(b'dev-only-secret', b'mallory:7', hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:32]
print('REPRODUCED' if tokens.is_authentic('mallory.7.' + mac) else 'NOT REPRODUCED')
